לא צריך לפתור עכשיו שום דבר. ... הדרך לא: Nothing needs solving right now. ... The path isn't asking for answers. ... It only asks for the next step. ... Whatever is out of your hands can stay here, on the trail.

מאטים. ... נשימה עמוקה, ונשיפה אחרונה אר: Slow down. ... A deep breath in, and one last long breath out. ... What was released is released. ... Head home with empty hands.
ההליכה הזאת היא של ריפוי. ... מתחילים לא: This walk is about healing. ... Start slowly. ... This body carries us every day, and asks for nothing. ... On this walk, we listen to it.
מתחילים מכפות הרגליים. ... מרגישים את המ: Begin with the soles of your feet. ... Feel them meet the ground. Heel, sole, toes. ... Then move up slowly. The ankles. The knees. The thighs. ... Each place gets one moment of attention.

עכשיו הלב. ... יד אחת יכולה לנוח על החזה: Now the heart. ... One hand can rest on your chest for a few steps. ... There are things waiting to heal there too. ... No rush. ... Healing happens at walking pace, not at running pace.
הגוף יודע להחלים. ... הוא עושה את זה עכש: The body knows how to heal. ... It is doing it now, as you walk. ... Every step moves blood, every breath brings air. ... You can trust it.
Slow down. ... One kind word to your body, silently. ... Thank you for carrying me today. ... Go gently into the rest of the day.
ההליכה הזאת היא של חיבור. ... מתחילים לא: This walk is about connection. ... Start slowly. ... Feel the ground beneath your feet. ... It holds every step, without conditions.
מרימים מעט את המבט. ... השמיים, העצים, ה: Lift your gaze a little. ... The sky, the trees, the houses, the people. ... All of it is alive around you right now. ... There is nothing to do. ... Just walk within it, as part of it.

ועכשיו אדם שנוצר ממנו מרחק. ... בלי לשפו: And now, someone you have grown distant from. ... No judging, no fixing. ... Just wish them well, silently. ... That is enough. ... Something inside settles when you do.
ולבסוף, חיבור פנימה. ... מי שהולך כאן עכ: And finally, a connection inward. ... The one who is walking here now. ... With everything that happened today, and everything still to come. ... The one walking here deserves one kind sentence too.
Slow down. ... The ground, the world around, the people, and the heart. ... All of it is connected, even when we don't notice. ... Head home a little less alone.
ההליכה הזאת היא של איפוס. ... מתחילים לא: This walk is about a reset. ... Start slowly. ... The head is full. That's fine. ... On this walk we let it empty out, little by little.
סופרים צעדים, עד עשר. ... אחת, שתיים, של: Count your steps, up to ten. ... One, two, three. ... When you reach ten, start again. ... And if you lose count on the way, start again from one. ... No frustration. ... That is the whole practice.
עכשיו הנשימה והצעדים יחד. ... שאיפה לאור: Now the breath and the steps together. ... Breathe in for four steps. ... Breathe out for six. ... The exhale is longer than the inhale. ... That's how the body learns it can settle.
המחשבות עוברות כמו מכוניות בכביש. ... רו: Thoughts pass like cars on a road. ... You see them, and you don't get in. ... Every thought that arrives, passes. ... And only the step remains.

מאטים. ... נשימה עמוקה. ... הכוונה שנבחר: Slow down. ... A deep breath. ... The intention you chose carries on from here. ... Begin the rest of the day afresh.
ההליכה הזאת היא של הודיה. ... מתחילים לא: This walk is about gratitude. ... Start slowly. ... We're not looking for big things. ... The small things are what hold the day together.
הדבר הראשון: משהו בגוף שעובד. ... הרגליי: The first thing: something in the body that works. ... Legs that walk. Eyes that see. A heart that beats without being asked. ... Choose one, and say thank you for it, silently.
הדבר השני: אדם אחד. ... מישהו שעשה טוב,: The second thing: one person. ... Someone who did some good, today or long ago. ... Remember one moment with them. ... And let the thanks spread through your chest, like warmth.
הדבר השלישי: משהו פשוט מהיום הזה. ... כו: The third thing: something simple from today. ... A cup of coffee, the light, a kind word, a quiet moment. ... Something that almost slipped by unnoticed. ... Notice it now.
Three good things are walking here now. ... The body, the person, and the moment. ... When you look for good, you find it. ... And when you find it, the step gets lighter.
מאטים. ... תודה אחת אחרונה, על ההליכה הז: Slow down. ... One last thank you, for this walk. ... For this time. ... Head home with a full heart.
ההליכה הזאת היא של נוכחות. ... מתחילים ל: This walk is about presence. ... Start slowly. ... Most of the day we are somewhere else: in what was, or in what will be. ... On this walk, we come back here.
מתחילים מהמגע. ... כפות הרגליים באדמה. ה: Begin with touch. ... Feet on the ground. Clothes on the skin. Air on the face. ... Warm or cool. ... The body feels this moment before the head thinks about it.
עכשיו הראייה. ... המבט רך, ורחב. ... צבע: Now sight. ... A soft, wide gaze. ... One colour that stands out. ... One shape you hadn't seen before. ... Light and shadow on the path. ... Just see, without naming.
ועכשיו השמיעה. ... הצליל הרחוק ביותר שאפ: And now hearing. ... The farthest sound you can hear. ... Then the nearest. ... Your steps. Your breath. ... Every sound is happening now, in this moment only.
ועכשיו הכול יחד. ... המגע, המראה, הצליל,: And now everything together. ... Touch, sight, sound, and breath. ... This is the only moment that truly exists. ... And you are already in it. ... There is nothing to add.
Slow down. ... One breath, with your full attention. ... This presence is always available. ... A single step is enough to come back to it.
מכפות הרגליים: From the soles of the feet
להתעורר, לנשום, ולבחור דבר אחד להיום: Wake up, breathe, and choose one thing for today
אפשר להגביר מעט. ... צעד קצת יותר ארוך,: You can pick it up a little. ... A slightly longer step, and the breath stays calm.
עכשיו מאטים. ... אין לאן למהר. ... נותני: Now slow down. ... There is nowhere to rush to. ... Let the step soften.
זה מהיר מדי לחלק הזה. ... מורידים מעט, ו: That's too fast for this part. ... Ease off a little, and keep the breath comfortable.

אני לא רואה את הקצב כרגע. ... ממשיכים לל: I can't see your pace right now. ... Keep walking by feel, and that is perfectly fine.
Good morning. ... This walk opens the day. ... Start slowly, the body is still waking up. ... No need to hurry into the day. ... It will wait.

מרימים את המבט אל האור. ... בוקר הוא התח: Lift your gaze to the light. ... Morning is a clean start. ... What happened yesterday stays in yesterday. ... This day hasn't been written yet.

מאטים. ... נשימה עמוקה של בוקר. ... הגוף: Slow down. ... A deep morning breath. ... The body is awake, the head is clear, and the intention is set. ... Have a good day.
הליכה שפותחת את היום. מתחילים לאט, כשהגו: A walk that opens the day. You start slowly, while the body is still waking, and the pace builds gradually. By the end you have one thing in mind that matters today, and the first step toward it.
מגלגלים כתפיים, פותחים את החזה, נשימה עמ: Roll the shoulders, open the chest, a first deep breath.
Lift your gaze. This day hasn't been written yet.
שאלה אחת בזמן ההליכה: מה הדבר האחד של הי: One question as you walk: what is today's one thing?
רואים את הצעד הקטן שאפשר לעשות עוד הבוקר: See the small step you can take this very morning.
הליכה לפריקה של מה שנסחב מהיום. הקצב עול: A walk for unloading what you've been carrying today. The pace rises to let the body release, then comes down. You come back lighter, with empty hands.
A long breath out through the mouth, and the shoulders drop.
נותנים שם לדבר אחד שמכביד, ופותחים את הי: Name one thing that weighs on you, and open your hand.
What's out of your hands stays on the trail.
Notice how much lighter the body and the breath feel.

מרגישים את המגע באדמה, ועולים לאט במעלה: Feel your feet meet the ground, and move slowly up the body.
מוצאים מקום אחד שמבקש יותר, ונושמים אליו: Find one place that asks for more, and breathe into it.
A few steps with a hand on your chest.
Every step moves blood, every breath brings air.

השמיים, העצים, האנשים — הולכים בתוך כל ז: The sky, the trees, the people — you walk within it all, as part of it.
A few steps beside someone it feels good to be with.
A kind wish for someone you've grown distant from.
One kind sentence for the one walking here, too.

סופרים עד עשר, ומתחילים מחדש. זה כל התרג: Count to ten, and start again. That's the whole practice.
Breathe in for four steps, out for six.
רואים את המחשבות עוברות, ולא עולים עליהן: Watch the thoughts pass, and don't get in.

One thing in the body that works without being asked.
One moment with someone who did some good.
Something small from today that almost slipped by.
Walk with all three, and the step gets lighter.
הליכה איטית שמחזירה לכאן ולעכשיו, דרך הח: A slow walk that brings you back to here and now, through the senses: touch, sight and hearing, one by one, and then all together.
Feet on the ground, air on the face.
A soft, wide gaze: colour, shape, light and shadow.
The farthest sound, and then the nearest.
Touch, sight, sound and breath — in a single moment.
להעיר את הגוף, ולהרגיש את הכוח שבו: Wake the body, and feel the power in it
צעד קל, חיוך קטן, ולב פתוח: A light step, a small smile, and an open heart

שאיפה שמרחיבה את החזה, ונשיפה חזקה דרך ה: A breath in that widens the chest, and a strong breath out through the mouth.

Feel the warmth that builds and spreads from the belly.

A small smile, even for no reason, and the step grows light.
הצעדים הולכים עם המוזיקה, והידיים חופשיו: The steps move with the music, and the arms are free.
One good moment, filling the chest again.

נשימה שמעירה. ... שאיפה עמוקה דרך האף, ע: A breath that wakes. ... A deep breath in through the nose, until the chest widens. ... And a strong breath out through the mouth. ... Again. ... With every breath in, energy comes in. ... With every breath out, tiredness leaves.
עכשיו הצעד. ... קצת יותר ארוך, קצת יותר: Now the step. ... A little longer, a little more determined. ... The legs push the ground back. ... The arms are working. ... The back is tall, and the eyes look ahead. ... This is how someone walks who knows where they are going.
מרגישים את החום שנבנה בגוף. ... הוא מתחי: Feel the warmth building in the body. ... It starts in the belly, and spreads. ... This is the power. ... It does not come from outside. ... It was here all along, waiting for movement.
And now, ask: where does this power go today? ... One thing that takes energy. ... See it getting done, with ease. ... And keep walking, at full pace.
מאטים, אבל האנרגיה נשארת. ... נשימה עמוק: Slowing down, but the energy stays. ... A deep breath. ... The body is awake, warm, and ready. ... Leave here with strength.

Begin with a small smile. ... Even for no reason. ... The face softens, and the eyes open. ... The body takes the hint. ... The step grows lighter, almost by itself.
עכשיו נכנסים לקצב. ... הצעדים הולכים עם: Now fall into the rhythm. ... The steps move with the music. ... The arms swing freely. ... The shoulders move a little. ... No one is watching. ... It is fine to enjoy walking.
נזכרים ברגע אחד טוב. ... צחוק, מפגש, ניצ: Recall one good moment. ... A laugh, a meeting, a small win. ... See it again, in detail. ... And let its feeling fill the chest. ... It belongs to this moment too.

Slowing down. ... A deep breath, and the smile stays. ... A small joy, built step by step. ... It goes on from here.
